About Falak Hall

Creating Unforgettable Wedding Celebrations

Located in the heart of Gujrat on Main GT Road, Falak Marriage Hall stands as a symbol of elegance and royal hospitality. With over a decade of experience organizing premium events, we deliver a seamless one-window solution for your most precious moments.

From enchanting stage designs to gourmet catering, our dedicated team ensures that every detail of your celebration is handled with perfection and care.

What We Offer

Luxury Services

Wedding Ceremony

Enchanting setups for your main event with premium décor, floral arrangements, and professional lighting systems.

Mehndi Events

Colorful and vibrant traditional arrangements that bring the magic of Mehndi nights to life.

Walima Reception

Sophisticated reception setups with elegant seating, fine dining, and a refined ambience.

Catering Services

Gourmet menus crafted by expert chefs — from traditional one-dish spreads to luxury multi-course banquets.

Luxury Decoration

Exclusive floral arrangements, state-of-the-art stage designs, and bespoke theme installations.

Photography & Video

Professional event photography and cinematic videography to preserve your most precious memories forever.
